title: Routing Playbook Editor: region-first rules with tier-aware fallback preview
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Problem statement: Customers want a single, customer-configurable editor in Console that lets them express routing policies combining region selection, tier routing (hosted/dedicated/private), and automatic fallback to alternative model variants when a target is unavailable or exceeds latency/cost budgets. The current Console screens are fragmented: region selectors live in deployment settings, tier assignment is obscured in capacity pages, and fallbacks are configured as low-level JSON in policy files. This ticket defines the product scope, UX flows, validation rules, and preview behavior for a unified "Routing Playbook Editor" UX.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Users can author a policy with one or more rules that combine: region constraints (include/exclude), tier preference ordering (hosted -> dedicated -> private), and a prioritized list of fallback model variants; 2) Editor enforces syntactic + semantic validation (no circular fallbacks, tiers must exist in customer account, region codes validated against available regions for the account); 3) Real-time preview pane shows simulated distribution of 10k requests and highlights where requests would route given sample latency/capacity thresholds; 4) Preview supports toggles for 'simulate region outage' and 'simulate capacity stress' and shows fallback counts; 5) Save flow persists as named Playbook, supports rollouts (canary %), and surfaces any warnings; 6) Unit and e2e feature tests and basic performance / rendering tests added to console test suite.
engineering_notes:
- Backend: new REST endpoint POST /playbooks/preview that accepts a policy and synthetic workload and returns routing allocations. See GitHub issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/8912.
- Use current routing simulator library (routing-sim v0.9) but extend to support tier-capacity modelling and region outage injection.
- Required: RBAC check to ensure playbook references only models/variants customer can access.
- Performance budget: preview response < 1.2s for typical policy + 10k-sample simulation. If simulation too slow, implement progressive sampling with streaming updates to preview pane.
- Backend owners: @eng-routing (primary), @infra-sim (support).
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Large playbooks may cause slow preview response -> Mitigation: progressive streaming preview + limit initial simulation to 10k synthetic requests and expose 'run full simulation' as background job.
- Risk: Customers may create unsafe fallback chains causing data locality/security concerns -> Mitigation: validation prevents cross-environment fallbacks unless explicit 'allow cross-tenant' flag set and security_review_required checkbox set.
- Risk: UI complexity -> Mitigation: tiered UX: simple mode (guided templates) and advanced mode (JSON editor with validation).
rollout_plan: 1) Alpha behind feature flag for internal accounts and 5 pilot customers. 2) Collect feedback for 2 weeks, iterate on validation messages and preview visualizations. 3) Beta: expand to all accounts with opt-in toggle. 4) GA: enabled by default, with migration guide for customers using legacy policy files. 5) Rollback: disable feature flag and revert playbook creation endpoint if critical bugs.
qa_checklist:
- Author policy with 3 rules including region include/exclude, tier order, and 2 fallback variants -> Save succeeds.
- Preview: toggle region outage for primary region -> routing shifts according to fallback priorities.
- Preview: simulate pinned latency threshold -> requests above threshold fallback.
- Validation: try to reference a non-existent tier/model -> editor shows inline error and blocks save.
- Security: confirm RBAC prevents referencing private-only variants from hosted-only orgs.
- Accessibility: keyboard navigation and screen reader labels for preview controls.
